category_summary:
**Bot Screen / Live Desktop Passthrough launch (lead story):** The week belonged to **Hermes Desktop** — **@NousResearch** announced [**Bot Screen** real-time streaming of any agent's session](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-ef6b4179c4fa) (419k views, 2,048 likes) and **@Teknium** followed with the [interactive desktop passthrough for **Hermes Agent**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-4784626f2a61) (176k views), letting users visually watch and take over the same machine their agent works on. An official [**@tonbistudio** walkthrough with docs](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d84a2bc0a85d) (559 likes) rounded out the launch, [amplified by **@Teknium**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d03d44ef66a9); lead-dev reactions like ["Finallllly!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-014ad26a44c6) and ["Much needed!"](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-48968e1c836e) (205 likes) signaled the feature was long-awaited and landed with strong excitement.

**oh-my-hermes ecosystem:** **@rlaope** had a productive week, [open-sourcing **jeval** for Jev evaluation/visualization](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-8530d32deea5) and [shipping a major **oh-my-hermes (OMH)** update adding **Jev skills** and **model routing**](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-415aecf318f8) (aliases, plugins, workflow routing, fast decision-making), [positioning OMH as the all-in-one plugin for **hermes-agent** users](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-b4d141253a4f) — grassroots momentum despite modest engagement.

**Tips & maintainer presence:** **@NousResearch** shared [a practical tip to use Hermes via **iMessage** with any model of choice](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-768697783517). **@Teknium** stayed highly visible in the threads: [correcting an attribution error](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-992950038a21) (the work "is by us," not Anthropic), [disputing a cache-bug report while directing users to file reproducible issues](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-d5a2f794eeec), and [confirming a quick fix for community-reported feedback](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-3e1742f36c0b). Sentiment is celebratory around the launch and appreciative of responsive maintainer support; [one contrarian community take](/?date=2026-09-24&category=social#item-797e0ee6c95e) praised **Claude Opus 5.5** (GA 2026-09-22) while staying skeptical of **Claude Code**. Low-substance emoji replies and link drops were deprioritized.

You can now watch your agents work live as Hermes Desktop streams the screen of any bot's screen or session in real time. 

Watch it drive a browser, type into a terminal, or open a window. Take over anytime to interact with the Bot Screen or type credentials and seamlessly hand back off when you're done.
